fixture_rule: Saved block seed shared by all variants and encoded with parameter, phase and iteration by derand-shake256-v1
stopping: Five separately launched complete sessions; retain failed attempts; no effect-dependent reruns or extension
analysis: Process medians -> paired block effects -> session medians -> median of five session estimates
box_definition: Inclusive interpolated quartiles of 60 block effects; pooled block median; full min-max whiskers; all dots retained; descriptive only
exclusions: No trimming or timer overhead subtraction; any failed execution, source/assembly identity, round trip or integrity check invalidates the attempt
